text:
marie: Heads-up — after the recent KV-cache heuristic tweak the streaming path feels staccato for certain workloads. p95 inter-token jumped ~55ms -> ~170ms, p99 also worse. Not a throughput collapse, more like jittery emission cadence.
akash: Got it. Any profiler dumps or flame graphs? That smells like microbatch scheduling aligning badly with kernel selection pauses.
marie: Quick profiler summary pasted from perf-runner: 
```
emit_interval_ms=40 => p95 inter-token ~170ms
emit_interval_ms=12 => p95 inter-token ~62ms
microbatch_target=32 => good tokens/sec, p99 spikes
microbatch_target=6 => smoother per-token emits, tokens/sec -6%
kv_cache_hit_rate +12% but scheduler_wait_variance increased
kernel_switch_count per request also went up
```
jamal: So we traded raw compute for alignment jitter. If scheduler waits to fill batches and a kernel swap happens when a batch is ready, that creates a mid-stream stall.
sylvia: UX note: first-token latency remains fine, but users perceive pauses between tokens much more than aggregate throughput. Our perceived-latency SLO should capture inter-token smoothness.
marie: I ran a local adaptive emitter experiment. Config we tried: 
```
streaming:
  policy: active-adaptive
  initial_ms: 10
  steady_ms: 60
  aggressiveness: medium
  kernel_prewarm_tokens: 3
```
Outcome: p95 inter-token down to ~70ms, throughput cost <4%, p99 improved slightly. Edge cases remain when a kernel swap happens mid-stream.
akash: Two actionables: 1) adaptive emit window that decays after stream becomes active (fast emits) and grows for long steady streams; 2) kernel prewarm threshold: if upcoming microbatch will flip kernels (e.g., quant->fp16), force an early small flush to avoid mid-stream swap.
jamal: Also add telemetry: token_emit_interval_ms histogram per model+region, plus tags: kernel_state_at_emit, microbatch_size_at_emit. Correlate kernel_swap events with large inter-token gaps.
sylvia: And a composite UX metric for A/B: stream_smoothness = fraction_intervals_below_100ms + inverse_stddev_intervals. Use that to drive rollouts.
ci-bot: Canary deploy queued: feature-flag streaming.adaptive_active_2026 -> 5% canary (p95 target <120ms). Collect 72h histograms. :rocket: 
marie: I'll attach perf traces, flame graphs, and the synthetic client harness to the issue. Need a client script that mixes short prompts (1-4 tokens) with long continuations to exercise jitter.
akash: I'll add a harness variant to perf repo and dashboards for p95/p99 per emit-class. Will also log kernel_swap boolean and microbatch sizes.
jamal: Cool. Reconvene after 72h of canary telemetry. Thanks all :thumbsup:
